svg.text: Debug artifact. Not a panel, never part of an art-seed package, never shown to an artistic agent.
Every cell draws the same scene and the same sanctuary. Only the station point and the lens differ.
The rejected raises are kept on the sheet on purpose: they are the argument against moving a camera to rescue an object.
A standing eye in the nave, back far enough for a long lens.
Same eye, too close: the figures crowd the altar off the plate.
A child's eye. The mensa closes up and the steps stack.
The previous preset. Above every head, so the treads open out.
Raised once to make a flat Missal legible. Wrong instrument.
Raised again. By here the plate is an engineering overhead.
